Maya (CSM): FYI KryptonWare renewal ~6w. Usage down ~50% past 30d, embeddings & rerank worst. AE says customer opened a NebulaAI POC. Need quick triage.
Jordan (AM): Any obvious trigger? recent deploy or quota?
Maya (CSM): They rotated keys on 2024-11-02 and paused nightly batch scoring. Some power users marked inactive.
Devon (SE): Logs show spikes of 429 + occasional 502 on /embed after key rotation. Snippet: `ERROR 429 quota exceeded`
Luca (AE): Can we stall with a short Dedicated trial or promo credit while we fix?
Devon (SE): Low-risk fix: enable prefix KV caching + 1.5x concurrency for 72h + debug logging. I can push an account override and run a smoke test. Example override: `kv_cache: prefix_on, concurrency: 1.5`
Maya (CSM): Good. Jordan please export top routes + inactive seats by EOD and post link. Luca please draft a procurement-friendly offer and 1-page Nebula comparison. I'll set up a 30m revive call with Priya + Evan + our exec. If no reply in 72h escalate to RevOps.
Jordan (AM): Uploading export now: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exports/kryptonware_1778889999.csv (internal).
Devon (SE): Override staged to prod. Smoke curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer prod-krypton' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embed -d '{"input":"test"}'` Tail latency sample <400ms.
Maya (CSM): Recap actions: Jordan - heatmap (EOD). Devon - override + regression harness (48h). Luca - trial offer + slide (48h). Maya - invite + agenda. Reconvene after smoke and before call. Escalate if no engagement in 72h. :hourglass:
